page: Google Cloud Platform a2-ultragpu-8g is an accelerator-optimized server featuring eight NVIDIA Ampere A100 GPUs with a total of 640 GB VRAM. The system is powered by an Intel Xeon x86_64 processor providing 96 dedicated vCPUs across 48 physical cores, running at a base frequency of 2.2 GHz. It is equipped with 1360.0 GB of system memory, translating to 14.17 GB per core, and includes 3216 GB of local NVMe SSD storage.

Benchmark data highlights a clear distinction between single-core and multi-core or parallelized performance. Single-core metrics, such as stress-ng single-core CPU and Geekbench single-core scores, fall into the bottom 25% tier. Conversely, multi-core and parallel capabilities are highly robust, with stress-ng multi-core CPU performance and Geekbench software compilation scoring in the top 25%. Memory bandwidth is exceptionally strong for read operations, reaching 4212.24 GB/sec for small cached blocks and 192.49 GB/sec for large blocks, though write bandwidth is moderate at 84.61 GB/sec.

This server demonstrates top-tier performance in large language model inference tasks. Prompt processing speeds reach 6558.71 tokens/sec for small models, 2778.15 tokens/sec for medium models, and 410.88 tokens/sec for large models. Text generation speeds also scale efficiently, achieving 110.69 tokens/sec on medium models and 20.62 tokens/sec on large models.

The qualitative cost profile of this server reflects its high-density hardware class, combining massive GPU acceleration with substantial system memory and local NVMe storage. While single-threaded tasks are inefficient on this architecture, the server is highly optimized for parallel workloads. It is best suited for large-scale deep learning, LLM training and inference, high-performance computing, and complex data science pipelines.
